title: Optimistic Updates
description: Learn how to update UI optimistically before server confirms.

data.text: **Optimistic updates** update the UI immediately when a mutation is triggered, then rollback if it fails. This makes your app feel instant.

data.title: Optimistic Update
Rollback
data.text: Always implement rollback in onError to revert the optimistic update if the mutation fails.

data.title: Key Takeaways
data.takeaway: Optimistic updates make apps feel instant.
